skirmish.module.lag_meter.name: Lag Detector
skirmish.module.lag_meter.description: Server TPS (from world time packets), your ping and the time since the last packet. When the server goes silent, a big warning: do not move until it answers.
skirmish.module.lag_meter.setting.hud.to: A "TPS · ping · silence" pill in the bottom-right corner
skirmish.module.lag_meter.setting.show.t: Always, or only when TPS is below 18 or the server has been silent for over a second
skirmish.module.lag_meter.setting.warnin: A big notice when nothing has arrived from the server for a while
skirmish.module.lag_meter.setting.warn_a: The server sends packets at least once a second; a longer pause raises the warning
A short sound when a stall starts (only you hear it)
skirmish.lag.banner.title: Server not responding for %s s — don't move
skirmish.lag.banner.body: Movement during a stall gets rejected later, or kicked for
